Why Study in United Kingdom?

Country-specific advantages for academic and career progression

1-Year Fast-Track Master’s

Graduate with a globally recognized Master’s degree in just 12 months, saving an entire year of living expenses and tuition.

2-Year Graduate Route (PSW)

Work full-time in any sector across the UK for 2 full years after graduation without employer sponsorship.

Generous Partial Scholarships

Merit-based international student scholarships ranging from £1,500 to £5,000 deducted directly from 1st-year tuition fees.

Global Academic Prestige

Degrees from UK institutions are respected worldwide, giving Bangladeshi graduates competitive career advantages.

Education Pathway for Bangladeshi Students

Step-by-step qualification progression for SSC, HSC, Diploma, and Bachelor graduates

Pathway 1

SSC / O-Level

International Foundation Year → 3-Year Bachelor Degree

Bridge the 12-year education gap with a 9-month Foundation course at leading pathway colleges.

Pathway 2

HSC / A-Level

Direct Bachelor Degree (Year 1) or International Year One

Students with strong HSC GPA (3.5+) or A-Levels enter directly into Year 1 of standard 3-year degrees.

Pathway 3

Diploma (4-Year BTEB)

Final Year Top-Up Degree (1 Year) → Bachelor Degree

Polytechnic Diploma holders from Bangladesh can complete their Bachelor's in just 1 year in the UK.

Pathway 4

Bachelor Degree (4 Years)

1-Year Master's Degree (MSc / MA / MBA)

Direct admission for Bachelor graduates with 55%+ from UGC recognized Bangladeshi universities.

* Final eligibility depends on university, course, academic profile, English score, study gap and other admission requirements.

Entry Requirements & AI Eligibility Checker

Country-specific admission criteria for Bangladeshi qualifications

Undergraduate (Bachelor) Requirements
Academic: HSC GPA 3.5+ or A-Levels (BBB/BBC)
English: IELTS 6.0 (no band < 5.5) or PTE 54
Postgraduate (Master's) Requirements
Academic: Bachelor 4-Year with CGPA 2.75+ or 55%+
English: IELTS 6.5 (no band < 6.0) or PTE 59 or MOI
Top-up Degree (Final Year) Requirements
Academic: 4-Year BTEB Diploma or 3-Year Degree with 60%+
English: IELTS 6.0 (no band < 5.5) or PTE 54

United Kingdom Student Visa Process

Official step-by-step roadmap from university offer to visa stamp

1

University Offer Letter

Submit academic transcripts and SOP to receive Conditional or Unconditional Offer.

2

Meet Conditions & Pay Deposit

Submit English test report and pay university tuition deposit (typically £3,000 - £5,000).

3

Pre-CAS Credibility Interview

Complete internal university credibility mock interview with ALO guidance.

4

CAS Issuance

Receive official Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) statement from university.

5

Prepare Bank Statement

Maintain 28-day bank statement showing tuition balance + living costs (£9,207 or £12,006).

6

Visa Application & Biometrics

Submit UK VI online application, pay IHS health fee, and give biometrics at VFS Dhaka/Sylhet.

Work Rights & Post-Study Route Summary

Official government rules for international students in United Kingdom

Term-Time Work Rights:

20 hours per week

Vacation Work Rights:

Full-time (40 hours per week) during official university vacations

Post-Study Work Route:

2-year Graduate Route Post-Study Work Permit for Bachelor/Masters, 3 years for PhD.

* Visa and work rules can change. Always verify final conditions with official government sources and ALO staff before making decisions.

Frequently Asked Questions

Country-specific answers verified by ALO Education compliance

Can I study in the UK from Bangladesh with a study gap?

Yes, UK universities accept study gaps of 2 to 5 years for Bachelor's and up to 8 years for Master's programs provided you present valid work experience letters.

What is a CAS letter in UK admission?

CAS stands for Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies. It is an official electronic document issued by your UK university needed to apply for the UK Student Visa.

How much bank balance is required for UK student visa from Bangladesh?

You must show your remaining 1st-year tuition fee + living cost (£12,006 for Inner London or £9,207 for Outer London) held in an approved bank for at least 28 consecutive days.

Is IELTS mandatory for UK student visa?

While IELTS is preferred, many UK universities accept alternative tests like PTE Academic, OIETC ELLT, or Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificates from recognized Bangladeshi universities.

Can I bring my spouse or dependents to the UK?

Under current UK Home Office rules, international students enrolled in postgraduate research programs (PhD/Doctoral) or government-sponsored courses can bring dependents.

How long is the UK Graduate Route Post-Study Work Visa?

Graduates of Bachelor's and Master's degrees receive a 2-year Graduate Route visa to work in the UK. PhD graduates receive 3 years.

What is the tuition fee deposit for UK universities?

Most UK universities require an initial tuition deposit between £2,000 and £5,000 to issue the CAS statement.

Can polytechnic diploma students apply to the UK?

Yes, 4-year BTEB diploma graduates can apply directly for 1-year Top-up degree programs to graduate with a full British Bachelor's degree.

What is the Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS)?

The IHS fee gives international students full access to the UK National Health Service (NHS) during their stay (£776 per year for students).

When are the main intakes for UK universities?

The primary intake is September/October, the secondary intake is January/February, and select universities offer a May intake.

What documents are required for university application?

Academic certificates, mark sheets, valid passport, SOP, CV, two recommendation letters, and English language certificate.

How long does UK visa processing take in Bangladesh?

Standard processing at VFS Global Dhaka/Sylhet takes 15 working days. Priority visa takes 5 working days, and Super Priority takes 24 hours.

What is a Pre-CAS Credibility Interview?

It is an interview conducted by the university to assess your genuine student intentions, course knowledge, financial readiness, and career plans.

Are scholarships available for Bangladeshi students in the UK?

Yes, UK universities offer automatic partial scholarships of £1,000 to £5,000 based on academic grades, plus prestigious Chevening scholarships.

Can I work part-time while studying in the UK?

Yes, international students on a Student Visa can work up to 20 hours per week during term time and 40 hours per week during official holidays.

What is Medium of Instruction (MOI) waiver?

If your Bachelor's degree in Bangladesh was taught entirely in English at an approved university, some UK universities waive the IELTS requirement.

What bank accounts are accepted for the 28-day financial statement?

Savings or current personal accounts in the student's name or parents' names at standard commercial banks in Bangladesh.

Can I switch to a UK Skilled Worker Visa after graduation?

Yes, once you secure a qualifying job offer from a Home Office licensed sponsor meeting the minimum salary threshold, you can switch from Graduate Route to Skilled Worker visa.

What happens if my UK student visa is refused?

You can request an Administrative Review if an official casework error occurred, or address the refusal grounds and reapply with ALO counselor guidance.

Does ALO Education charge any service fee for UK university admission?

No, ALO Education provides 100% free counseling, course matching, university admission processing, and scholarship application support.
